true_answer: Therefore: | A ∪ B ∪ C | | 12 + 5 + 8 − 2 − 6 − 3 + 1 | 15 . This is what we got when we solved the problem using Venn diagrams. This process of adding in, then taking out, then adding back in, and so on is called the Principle of Inclusion/Exclusion , or simply PIE.
